draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.86, the 1st-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 1st of 35 at WR. He went 6th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Justin Jefferson. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (81st percentile), vertical jump (97th percentile). College production: his final season (2023) ranked 2nd in receiving yards among the 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the New York Giants. 19 career games and 17 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2025 against a career-best 9 in 2024. Weak spots: catch rate 51.4% (10th percentile). Played 4 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 wide receiver who played: 271 receiving yards against a median of 290, below the norm.
